title: Consolidate Sketchpad I18n Into Elements Ui
description: Remove sketchpad-local i18n ownership. Move general i18n setup and translation resources into elements/ui so all UI packages use a shared multi-language API. Replace separate sketchpad locale JSON files with a single shared source code definition and update sketchpad to consume it.
summary: Moved sketchpad-owned i18n setup and EN/DE translation resources into elements/ui as a single in-source bundle, removed sketchpad/i18n.ts and the locale JSON files, switched sketchpad to the shared initialized i18n API, updated stale semio/js imports that blocked startup, and extended the existing Home Playwright test with a German-language assertion.
